notablePrerequisites:
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature with mana value six or greater.
description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value six or greater, adding at least six {B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning the creature with mana value six or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
